title: RARE ELEMENT GUNS ON ELITE PILLAGERS
why: His g-36 answer: Yes, a rare element gun. A quarter of elite pillagers now carry a takeable MK III element gun, selected without a new random draw. Watch: element guns from pillagers may make the forge MK III feel less special, and a MK III elite hits harder; watch how often you find one.
now: The held gun, body loot and party container words preserve the element. Enemy rounds stay plain and warning red.
